Guidelines
ASCO Guidelines provide evidence-based recommendations and outline appropriate methods of treatment and care for
clinicians. The guidelines address specific clinical situations (disease-oriented) or the use of approved medical
products, procedures, or tests (modality-oriented). Multidisciplinary panels of experts, including patient advocates,
develop ASCO Guidelines.
